head: Netflix now comes with a T-Mobile plan
dek: T-Mobile's new T-Mix plans include a streaming service: pick Netflix or Hulu (with ads), Apple TV, YouTube Premium Lite and more, from $55 a month.
details: The $75 plan adds a second pick, like YouTube Premium or Game Pass. You can switch your picks 4 times a year.
where: US, new T-Mix plans from November
means: On T-Mobile in the US? A streaming service can now come with your phone plan, so look at the T-Mix plans before you pay for one separately.
todo: The new plans start in November. You can switch your streaming picks 4 times a year.
